title: K1731 worktree-main integration: clear stale-base so F1 shards can run

claude_followup.brief: Collect: (1) read experiments/k1731/k1731_main_integration_report.json and check each of the 5 conflict resolutions and test outputs; confirm the rev11/rev12 freeze-integrity gate and ratchet in experiment_gates.py survived AND that main-side changes over 1233 commits were not swallowed; (2) re-run pytest scripts/tests/test_experiment_gates.py and test_nested_dm_misuse_ratchet.py yourself - do not trust the report self-assessment; (3) run bash scripts/merge_worktree.sh --dry-run dispatch-slot-1-bd00f90a-k1731 to confirm STALE-BASE ABORT is gone; (4) only if all pass, run the real merge_worktree.sh; (5) after merge run uv run python scripts/compute_queue.py requeue --id k1731-f1-boot-c0-parametric and --id k1731-f1-boot-c0-block to put the two F1 shards (22h/11h) back to run - README 11.6 names requeue as the intended recovery path; (6) if integration failed or any gate was weakened, do NOT merge - record and escalate.
